mgmt_bio.text: "Dave" Ricks is chair and chief executive officer of Eli Lilly and Company. He led Lilly Bio-Medicines from 2012 to 2016, was president of Lilly USA, the company's largest affiliate, from 2009 to 2012, served as president and general manager of Lilly China from 2008 to 2009, and was general manager of Lilly Canada from 2005 to 2008, after joining the company as a business development associate.
